findings.current: A deep conversation I’d had with the Bow Saint at the Imperial Palace, the first time we met.
findings.defect: Says they first met at the Imperial Palace; the source identifies it as their first deep conversation, not their first meeting.
findings.rationale: 처음으로 modifies the deep conversation they shared, not the occasion on which they met.
findings.replacement: The first deep conversation I’d had with the Bow Saint at the Imperial Palace.
findings.source: 황궁에서 처음으로 나누었던 궁성과의 깊은 대화.

findings.current: No—there had been one other time, but that was only when I was in the middle of an important Quest, and even then it hadn’t happened like this.
findings.defect: Invents a count of exactly one previous occurrence.
findings.rationale: 있었긴 했지만 acknowledges prior occurrences without specifying how many.
findings.replacement: No—it had happened before, but only when I was in the middle of an important Quest, and even then it hadn’t happened like this.
findings.source: 아니, 있었긴 했지만 그건 중요한 퀘스트를 진행 중이었을 때뿐이었고 그마저도 이런 방식은 아니었다.

findings.defect: Removes the profanity from Taekyung’s immediate reaction.
findings.rationale: 지랄 gives the thought a blunt, profane edge that the current line lacks.

findings.current: Someone who could interfere with my mind.
findings.defect: Broadens intrusion into Taekyung’s private inner mental space into general interference with his mind.
findings.rationale: 나만의 심상 specifies his own inner mental landscape, which matters to how the voice reached him.
findings.replacement: Someone who could intrude into my private inner world.
findings.source: 나만의 심상(心想)에 개입할 수 있을 정도의 누군가.

findings.current: “Guess it runs in the family—even this works.”
findings.defect: “Even this works” does not convey the brothers’ apparent connection or agreement.
findings.rationale: 한 핏줄 points to shared blood, while 이런 것까지 통하는구나 says that their thoughts connect even over this.
findings.replacement: “Must be because we’re brothers. Even on this, we’re of one mind.”

findings.current: On top of that, the significant words it left behind before Erasure hinted at more trouble to come.
findings.defect: Uses the capitalized term “Erasure” as an event name where the source simply says the Doppelganger ceased to exist.
findings.rationale: 소멸하기 전 describes what happened to the Doppelganger; 의미심장한 carries an ominous implication here.
findings.replacement: On top of that, the ominous words it left behind before it vanished hinted at more trouble to come.
findings.source: 더군다나 놈이 소멸하기 전 남겼던 의미심장한 말들은 또 다른 후환(後患)을 암시하고 있어

findings.current: The next moment, the unwelcome guest opened the door without hesitation. No—Jin Wikyung’s expression was heavy and grave.
findings.defect: The self-correction shifts awkwardly from the guest’s identity to his expression, obscuring Taekyung’s recognition.
findings.rationale: 아니 corrects the identification of the person who entered before describing his expression.
findings.replacement: The next moment, the unwelcome guest opened the door without hesitation. No—it was Jin Wikyung, his expression heavy and grave.
findings.source: 다음 순간 망설임 없이 문을 열고 들어온 불청객. 아니 진위경의 표정은 무겁게 가라앉아 있었다.

summary: The draft is largely faithful, but it softens Taekyung’s reaction, adds two unsupported scene or quantity claims, and loses meaning in the final dialogue.
